## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the stated repository responsibility.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior and required checks pass.
- [ ] Security, dependency, data migration, and rollback impacts are understood.
- [ ] Public interfaces and compatibility metadata are updated when needed.
- [ ] User, developer, operations, and release documentation remain accurate.
